data.title: 奥萝拉 · 霓虹雨夜的耳畔呢喃
data.description: 繁华现代商业街的细雨街角，霓虹招牌与路灯在湿漉地表倒映出迷离光斑。奥萝拉挽着暗影的手臂贴近他耳畔轻语，紫眸中流转着狐狸般的狡黠。
data.location: rain-slicked metropolitan street corner illuminated by neon shop signs and streetlights
data.action: linking arms close with partner, leaning near his ear with a playful teasing whisper, wet dark hair, seductive violet eyes
data.lighting: 霓虹招牌彩光与细雨路灯暖黄倒影
data.promptProse: Aurora in a modern camel coat links arms tightly in the rainy neon street, leaning close to whisper with a mischievous, sultry gaze.
data.animaCaption: Vibrant neon street reflections shimmer on wet pavement as she whispers teasingly.
